title: dryopteris tomentosa
intro: Dryopteris tomentosa, commonly known as Japanese shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris tomentosa include modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
